name: Maximize Channeling
body:
Damage dealt or healed by your channeled energy is maximized.

Prerequisite: Channel energy class feature

Benefit: Three times per day, the damage dealt or healed by your Channel Energy class feature is the maximum possible. The save DC to halve the damage dealt is unmodified.
